fact: The Bank of Sierra Leone's representative cited the central bank's launch of the National Switch among its inclusion efforts.
PAPSS lists eight Sierra Leonean banks (UBA, SLCB, Access, Bloom, Rokel, GTBank, Vista, FBNBank) as live, update May 2025.

The Bank of Sierra Leone launched a national payment switch in April 2023 and on 13 February 2025 a national instant payment switch linking seven banks and two mobile money operators, with full integration due by 1 April 2025.

fact: The Bank of Sierra Leone runs the Salon Payment Switch, now including all commercial banks, and an Instant Payment System, as the bank's National Switch Department head says.
